title: Everglades Airboat Ride and Nature Walk Private Tour
blurb:
Explore the unique ecosystem of Everglades National Park on this fully private immersive tour! This tour features a one-hour airboat ride followed by a nature walk led by an experienced naturalist. Discover the diverse wildlife, including alligators and various bird species, while learning about the park's conservation efforts and ecological significance. Enjoy transportation from Miami or Fort Lauderdale, with the option for private tours. This adventure is perfect for families and nature enthusiasts looking to experience Florida's natural wonders firsthand.

- Tour duration: 5 - 6 hours (including transportation). 
- Scenic drive & 1.5-hour guided nature walk w/ a Biologist or Naturalist. 
- Transportation from hotels in Miami & Fort Lauderdale w/ flexible options.
- Private thrilling airboat ride in the famous "River of Grass"!
- Tons of wildlife viewing opportunities! 
- Snacks & drinks also included.
